name: Pakistan: freelancers and IT exporters

vatRates.note: Federal sales tax on goods; services are taxed by the provinces (Punjab and Islamabad 16%, Sindh 15%)

tests: 183 days in the tax year, or 120 days plus 365 days in the four previous years

source.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Pakistan, residence

dueNote: The tax year runs July to June and returns are due on 30 September; a calendar year's reserve is released on 30 September of the next year. Final tax on export proceeds is withheld or paid as the proceeds arrive.

presets.label: IT services exported, PSEB-registered: final tax 0.25% of export proceeds
IT services exported, not PSEB-registered: final tax 1% of export proceeds
Services in Pakistan: provincial sales tax 16% (Punjab, Islamabad) + income tax reserve 30%

notes: The reduced final-tax rates apply to export proceeds received through banking channels; check with FBR whether stablecoin receipts qualify before relying on them.
Provincial sales tax on services differs by province: Sindh 15%, Punjab and Islamabad 16%.
